newsitem.title: USA: UPI names James Adams as CEO.
newsitem.headline: UPI names James Adams as CEO.

text.p: United Press International said it named James Adams as chief executive, effective June 16.
The decision, said privately held UPI, comes as part of a major strategic reorganization and refocusing designed to secure the company financially and expand operations into new areas.

Adams, previously Washington Bureau Chief for UPI, was formerly managing editor of the Sunday Times of London, where he was responsible for the newspaper's $40 million budget and masterminded the paper's move to new technology, a step that helped transform its fortunes.
United Press International, headquartered in Washington, is a global news wire service with 40 news bureaus throughout the world.
